افترسا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَسَا (iftarasā) /if.ta.ra.saː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# اُفْتُرِسَا (ufturisā) /uf.tu.ri.saː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# اِفْتَرِسَا (iftarisā) /if.ta.ri.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
